text:
# listing.location

TL;DR:
- listing.location is the expanded location entity for the listing.

What it means:
- It gives the human-readable resolved place for the listing instead of only a raw locationId.
- It is the preferred source when explaining where the listing is located.

Agent hint:
- Prefer the expanded location object over locationId when talking to a user. See zbav://mcp/entity/location for full entity context.
